Pre-alpha build. Expect rough edges.

Download the `.zip` below, right-click it → **Extract All**, and run `gigeyes.exe`. Setup and usage are in the [README](https://github.com/DarkKnightDev01/GigEyes#readme), which is also inside the zip.

**What it does now**
Drop in a song or an isolated guitar track, or paste a YouTube or other video link. GigEyes sums the tone up in one line ("High-gain, with scooped mids, a bright top and a big low end."), turns an amp's Gain, Bass, Middle, Treble and Presence knobs to where the recording sits, and draws its EQ curve. Hover a knob or a bar for the number behind it. Downloads from links are deleted right after reading.

**Known limits**
- The knob positions are rough starting points on an amp with its EQ flat at noon, not settings for your plugins yet.
- The Gain reading is a rough guess and can call a compressed track clean.
- webm and opus files don't open yet (links work).
- Windows may warn that the app is from an unknown publisher, because it isn't code-signed yet. Click "More info" → "Run anyway".
